description: This Java source file defines the OrderEvents class, which contains static methods for handling order-related HTTP requests in the OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities such as downloading digital products and canceling selected order items.

classes.name: OrderEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling order-related events such as digital product downloads and order item cancellations.

methods.name: downloadDigitalProduct
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to download a digital product associated with an order, verifies purchase, and streams the data resource to the response.

methods.name: cancelSelectedOrderItems
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to cancel selected items in an order, invoking the cancelOrderItem service for each selected item.
